faq.title: Before you book a demo.
faq.q1_summary: Do I need a new phone number?
faq.q1_answer: No. We can forward your existing clinic number to Nexora, or set up call forwarding only for after-hours and busy periods — whichever fits your workflow. Your number stays the same.
faq.q2_summary: Will patients know they're speaking to an AI?
faq.q2_answer: The AI introduces itself honestly, but it's built to sound natural, understand context, and handle real conversations — not read from a script. Most patients are focused on getting an answer, not on who's giving it.
faq.q3_summary: What happens if the AI can't answer something?
faq.q3_answer: Complex or sensitive calls are transferred to your team in real time, with a summary of the conversation so far. The AI is built to know its limits, not guess.
faq.q4_answer: Most clinics are live within 5–7 working days. We handle the setup, train the AI on your treatments and pricing, and test everything with you before go-live.
faq.q5_answer: Yes. All conversations and data are handled in line with UK GDPR requirements, with a data processing agreement in place for every clinic we work with.
faq.q6_summary: Can I cancel if it's not working for my clinic?
faq.q6_answer: Plans are billed monthly. AI Reception is month-to-month, while our AI Growth and AI Scale plans carry a short initial commitment so the system has time to bed in. The exact commitment and terms are always confirmed in your proposal before you start.
faq.q7_answer: Yes. Your AI Receptionist can answer calls day and night, including evenings, weekends and public holidays.
faq.q8_answer: Yes. It can connect with your calendar and booking system to check availability and confirm appointments in real time.
faq.q9_answer: Yes. Urgent or sensitive calls can be transferred directly to your team, with full context of the conversation so far.
faq.q10_answer: Yes. The same AI can handle WhatsApp conversations alongside phone calls and Instagram DMs.
faq.q11_summary: Does it work in the UK?
faq.q11_answer: Yes. Nexora is built specifically for UK aesthetic clinics, with UK phone numbers, UK data handling standards, and UK patient expectations in mind.
